==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I appeased a blood bending Were-Bear who was after the Reality Warping Stone, by giving him a key to his own pocket universe. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.) (Blood Bear resembled a muscular humanoid purple bear with a large heart shaped scar on his chest.) (The pocket universe key resembled a glowing key covered in rainbow stripes.) (I tried to appease Blood Bear out of hope that I could avoid a direct confrontation with such a powerful opponent. I also really liked his aesthetic and honestly hoped that we could have been friends.)
He abused his newfound power by using it to get around and surprise attack the Elven Guard at the bank. (Blood Bear essentially used his pocket universe to teleport by stepping into from one location and out of it in another.) (The Elven Guard Badge resembles a wooden circle, with a silver trim, marked with a green spiral. Elven Guards normally wear the badge alongside a suit of sleek green armor that resembles foliage. As elves they of course have common elf features like tall pointed ears.)
I defeated him by reanimating the fallen guard, using the zombie to arrest him from afar. (Blood Bear's blood bending couldn't do much to stop the zombie, because the zombie was already dead.)
